title: The Cognitive Penalty
description: One frozen Qwen-3.5-9B judging adversarial Optimism DAO proposals, deliberation off vs on. System 1 holds every metric at 100%; reasoning drops robustness to 68.5%, flips 27% of verdicts, and costs 17x latency — a 226s window that is itself Governance-Extractable Value. Tap a row.
controls: hover, tap, or arrow-key a row for exact numbers
each dumbbell connects System 1 (think off) to System 2 (think on)
